headline: Elon Musk's Grokipedia has a 'newly refreshed' design
summary: Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered Wikipedia competitor, received a v0.3 design update. It now features a new logo and refreshed homepage and live edits page. This update follows recent reincorporation of edits.

headline: The new and huger Paramount has a new co-CEO
summary: Paramount appointed Ynon Kreiz as co-CEO ahead of its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Kreiz, formerly Mattel CEO, will lead alongside chairman and CEO David Ellison. Ellison will focus on the company's long-term strategy and creative vision.

headline: Neon sticks it to A24 by announcing a Creative Commons SCP Foundation movie
summary: A24 angered the SCP Foundation community by announcing a film without contacting the wiki team. A24 also failed to commit to releasing the film under a Creative Commons license. Neon capitalized on the misstep by announcing its own CC-licensed SCP Foundation movie.

headline: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it's so capable that only 'trusted cyber defenders' can have it right now
summary: Google unveiled its next AI frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon. The new model offers "frontier performance" in complex workflows like software engineering and finance. Access to Gemini 4 is currently limited to "trusted cyber defenders" due to its advanced capabilities.

headline: Extraction is Still a Major Part of Marathon – Game Director Reassures Fans Main Game Mode Isn't Going Anywhere
summary: Marathon's developers recently laid out a roadmap including new PvE and deathmatch modes. Fans expressed concern that the core extraction mode might be sunsetted. Game Director Del Chafe reassured players that extraction remains a major part of the game.

headline: The Flexispot Lotus Swivel Rocker and Recliner Is on Clearance for $250 Plus Free Shipping
summary: The Flexispot Lotus Swivel Rocker and Recliner is currently on clearance. It is available for $250. This deal includes free shipping.

headline: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered Review Update
summary: A review update for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered has been released. The updated version is lauded as the best iteration of the amazing RPG. It significantly enhances an already critically acclaimed game.

headline: The Moza R5 Racing Wheel Offers 5.5Nm of Direct Drive Force Feedback for an Affordable Price
summary: The Moza R5 Racing Wheel offers 5.5Nm of direct drive force feedback. It provides powerful haptic response at an affordable price. The racing wheel is currently on sale at Best Buy.

headline: Veteran broadcaster Dame Esther Rantzen dies aged 86
summary: Dame Esther Rantzen, a veteran broadcaster, has died at the age of 86. She presented BBC's 'That's Life' for two decades and founded the Childline charity. Rantzen was also a prominent campaigner for assisted dying.

headline: How That's Life! gave Esther Rantzen a career-defining moment
summary: Sir Nicholas Winton's story became national news through the BBC show 'That's Life!'. His appearance in February 1988 was a pivotal moment for the program. This segment became a career-defining highlight for presenter Esther Rantzen.

headline: US Supreme Court allows execution of Christa Pike to go ahead
summary: The US Supreme Court has allowed the execution of Christa Pike to proceed. Her death by lethal injection was previously scheduled for earlier today. A lower court had initially paused the execution.

headline: Employers should teach primary-age children about work, says Milburn
summary: A major UK report on youth activity suggests children should learn about careers at an early age. The report's author, Milburn, advocates for this education to begin as young as four. Employers are urged to participate in teaching primary-age children about the world of work.
